planSteps.description: Open the journal setup screen and give the new journal a unique name.
Remove all default rooms and try to create the journal with no rooms.
Assert that setup explains at least one room is required and no journal is created.
Add a Study room to the setup form.
Assert the Study room is listed before journal creation.
Create the journal with the Study room.
Assert the new journal is selected in the active journal control.
Assert Study appears in the new journal's room index.
